semiconductor_relevance: High — EMI specializes in power distribution solutions specifically designed for semiconductor applications, making it a key supplier in the semiconductor value chain.
summary: EMI is a leading manufacturer of Main Power Distribution Units (MPDU) and control boxes tailored for semiconductor equipment, ensuring compliance with international safety and quality standards. The company provides customized engineering and support throughout the product lifecycle, establishing long-term partnerships with major semiconductor manufacturers.
capabilities: Main Power Distribution Units (MPDU) for semiconductor applications
Customized engineering and enclosure design services

regional_presence.Korea: EMI is based in Korea and specializes in meeting the electrical specifications of major local semiconductor manufacturers like Samsung and SK Hynix.
